NeoCell PURE — Microfibrillated Cellulose for Personal Care Formulations

Your formulation needs structure.
Not necessarily more thickness.

NeoCell PURE gives formulators another way to build physical structure using microfibrillated cellulose (MFC).

Request Sample ↗

It is designed to be evaluated not simply as a thickener, but as a material that can help control how a formulation behaves before, during and after application.

What it solves

Hold dispersed material in place

Evaluate pigments, particles, capsules and other suspended solids.

Flow under shear

The structured network becomes easier to move during mixing, pumping or application.

Recover afterwards

Once shear falls, the cellulose network can rebuild physical structure.

Design texture differently

Explore pickup, spread, break and physical structure beyond peak viscosity alone.

How it functions

Dispersed cellulose fibrils interact to form a physical network in water. Evaluate how the network responds at rest, under shear and after shear in the finished formulation.

Understand MFC rheology ↗

Who should evaluate it

Formulation scientists, personal-care manufacturers, R&D teams and ingredient distributors comparing cellulose rheology modifiers, thickeners or suspension ingredients can discuss an evaluation with NeoNaar.

Buyer questions

Can microfibrillated cellulose modify rheology?

MFC networks can change flow and recovery behaviour. NeoCell PURE should be compared in the intended formula, with results assessed under relevant storage and application conditions.

What format does NeoNaar supply?

NeoCell PURE is presented as an aqueous gel / dispersion. Request the current technical data and confirm sample availability, solids content, packaging and storage guidance directly with NeoNaar.

Where is NeoNaar based?

NeoNaar Biotech Private Limited is based in Coimbatore, India.

How can companies evaluate NeoCell PURE?

Share your application, target behaviour and material requirement through the enquiry form. The team can discuss a sample and the technical information available for your evaluation.
